about_short_description.short_description: Finanshels is an accounting and financial services company that provides bookkeeping, tax compliance and financial management services.

product.name: Bookkeeping Services
product.description: Service that manages and records financial transactions to maintain accurate business accounts.

product.name: Tax Consultancy
product.description: Advisory service providing guidance on tax registration, compliance, and strategic tax planning for businesses.

product.name: Fractional CFO Services
product.description: Provision of part-time Chief Financial Officer expertise to support strategic financial management and decision-making.

product.name: Compliance Services
product.description: Services ensuring businesses meet regulatory requirements including Economic Substance Regulations and audit readiness.

product.name: Liquidation Services
product.description: Assistance with the formal closure and liquidation of companies in accordance with legal and financial regulations.

product.name: VAT Registration and Filing
product.description: Service to register businesses for VAT and manage ongoing VAT filing and compliance.
